name: MIDIMON
author: ignis32
tagline: a MIDI monitor, thru router and clock for the FM-1
description: A MIDI monitor for USB, the TRS jack and Bluetooth (as device and host at once): hex or words, filters, stats. Its THRU routes, each filtered, make the FM-1 a Bluetooth MIDI dongle.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp.
